CARE.definition: The work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something.

ACRE.gloss: a unit of area used in English-speaking countries

ERA.definition: A period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event.

EAR.gloss: the sense organ for hearing and equilibrium
EAR.definition: The sense organ for hearing and equilibrium.

ARC.gloss: electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field
ARC.definition: Electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field.

ACE.gloss: the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number
ACE.definition: The smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number.

ARK.definition: A boat built by Noah to save his family and animals from the flood.

RAKE.definition: Move through with or as if with a rake.
